augmentation_policy.contrast_center: one full-content mean luminance with coefficients 0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B
augmentation_policy.eligibility: target-bearing training images only; negative images unchanged to match future local controls
augmentation_policy.family_sampling: uniform over two families; uniform operation within selected family
augmentation_policy.intensity: RGB uint8 stored-code values /255; no linear-light conversion; clip to [0,1], round to nearest integer uint8; PIL blur returns uint8
augmentation_policy.noise: independent zero-mean Gaussian per pixel and RGB channel; local PCG64 generator
augmentation_policy.randomization: SHA-256 keyed by domain, seed, zero-based epoch, image path and purpose; independent of global Python/NumPy/Torch RNG; rejection-sampled discrete choices
augmentation_policy.schedule: fixed family probabilities and physical parameters; no detector feedback, class-specific settings or policy search
augmentation_policy.scope: transform full resized image content; composite once only inside selected group union with inward taper

budget: 20 epochs; one 24-hour PBS allocation, save and stop near 23 hours if unfinished. Resume is explicit; no automatic resubmission.
checkpoint_retention: All completed-epoch checkpoints plus latest intermediate checkpoint; full checkpoints remain on CCAST.

comparator.initialization: Fresh same COCO weights and seed, not epoch-14 learned weights

data_policy: Frozen train and val only. No test manifest or pixels opened. Stored orientation; include empty images and all valid difficult targets.

evaluation.coordinates: Inverse letterbox to original stored image, clip to image bounds, discard collapsed predictions only
evaluation.metrics: pycocotools bbox AP50:95/AP50/AP75, AR100, per-class AP50:95/AP50; no-target predicted box counts at confidence 0.25

initialization: COCO_V1; new 5-class ROI predictor; all backbone stages trainable; FrozenBatchNorm2d eps=0

local_policy.alpha: 0 outside union; 0.5 on its outer 8-neighbour boundary layer; 1 in the one-pixel-eroded union; one-pixel-wide supports retain alpha 0.5
local_policy.compositing: uint8 candidate from shared operation; round x + alpha*(candidate-x) once; no repeated overlap edits
local_policy.group_order: sort original object indices within groups, then sort groups lexicographically
local_policy.group_selection: uniform one group per augmented image, separate SHA-256 purpose; no resampling
local_policy.grouping: connected components of positive-area overlap of rasterized target boxes at prepared image resolution
local_policy.operation_reference: same full resized reference content and noise draw as image-level control before masked composition
local_policy.rasterization: clip float64 prepared boxes to content; floor minima, ceil maxima; half-open rectangles

purpose: Matched fixed local group-union augmentation versus verified fixed image-level control
recipe_status: Prospective fixed local application; same initial appearance recipe, no validation tuning or online controller
resume_policy: Same configuration/code/data/environment required; restore model, optimizer, RNG, epoch and next batch. CUDA bitwise identity not promised.
